description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractIndexer' within the 'SuiteCRM\Search\Index' namespace. It provides a base for implementing search indexers, including methods for indexing modules and beans, managing index state (differential or full), and logging. It references external classes and modules related to search, logging, and document transformation, and contains method signatures and a constructor with setup routines.

classes.name: AbstractIndexer
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for search indexers in SuiteCRM, including configuration management, module/bean indexing operations, and logging setup.

methods.name: getIndexerName
methods.description: Returns the short class name of the indexer instance.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Abstract method to perform indexing of the entire database, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Abstract method to index a specific module, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Abstract method to index a single SugarBean object.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Abstract method to index multiple SugarBean objects within a module.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a single SugarBean from the index.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Abstract method to remove multiple SugarBeans from the index.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to delete all records within a specified index.

methods.name: isDifferentialIndexing
methods.description: Checks whether differential (partial) indexing is enabled.

methods.name: getDocumentifier
methods.description: Returns the current Documentifier instance used for converting beans into index documents.

methods.name: setDocumentifier
methods.description: Sets the Documentifier instance used for index conversion.

methods.name: getDocumentifierName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the current Documentifier.

methods.name: getModulesToIndex
methods.description: Returns the list of modules designated for indexing.

methods.name: setModulesToIndex
methods.description: Overrides the list of modules to index in future runs.

methods.name: addModulesToIndex
methods.description: Adds additional modules to the indexing list.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Provides access to the internal Monolog logger instance.

methods.name: setupLogger
methods.description: Initializes and configures the logger with various handlers.
